question:
(i) State the principle of superposition of electrostatic forces.
(ii) Three charges are placed near a charge $q_0$. If the forces on $q_0$ due to the three charges are $\vec{F}_1$, $\vec{F}_2$ and $\vec{F}_3$, write the expression for the net force on $q_0$ and explain its vector nature.

options.A:
(i) The total force is the algebraic sum of the charge magnitudes
(ii) $\vec{F}_{\text{net}}=F_1+F_2+F_3$ only if all charges are positive
options.B:
(i) Only the nearest charge produces force on $q_0$
(ii) $\vec{F}_{\text{net}}=\vec{F}_1\vec{F}_2\vec{F}_3$
options.C:
(i) The individual force due to one charge changes because other charges are present
(ii) Net force has magnitude only and no direction
options.D:
(i) The net electrostatic force is the vector sum of forces due to each charge separately
(ii) $\vec{F}_{\text{net}}=\vec{F}_1+\vec{F}_2+\vec{F}_3$; vector addition is required because force has magnitude and direction
